summary: Called I/O subroutine used by the statement generator (CBSTM03A). It is a generic data-access layer: the caller passes a linkage area naming a file (DD) and an operation code (Open/Close/Read/Read-Keyed/Write/Rewrite) plus a key and a record buffer; the routine performs the requested operation on the matching file (transaction, cross-reference, customer, account) and returns the file status. Keeps all VSAM I/O in one reusable module.

paragraphs.name: 0000-START
paragraphs.pseudocode: Dispatch on the requested DD name: for TRNXFILE, XREFFILE, CUSTFILE or ACCTFILE, perform the matching file-processing paragraph (through its exit); any other DD returns immediately.
branches: EVALUATE LK-M03B-DD: TRNXFILE / XREFFILE / CUSTFILE / ACCTFILE / OTHER

annotations.note: Generic I/O dispatcher driven by the linkage DD name; the operation is selected by 88-level flags O/C/R/K/W/Z.

paragraphs.notes: Entry dispatcher of the reusable I/O module.

paragraphs.name: 1000-TRNXFILE-PROC
paragraphs.pseudocode: For the transaction file, execute the requested operation: Open input, Read into the caller's buffer, or Close.

paragraphs.name: 1900-EXIT
paragraphs.pseudocode: Return the transaction-file status to the caller's return-code field.

paragraphs.name: 2000-XREFFILE-PROC
paragraphs.pseudocode: For the cross-reference file, execute the requested operation: Open input, Read, or Close.

paragraphs.name: 2900-EXIT
paragraphs.pseudocode: Return the cross-reference file status to the caller.

paragraphs.name: 3000-CUSTFILE-PROC
paragraphs.pseudocode: For the customer file, execute the requested operation: Open input, keyed Read (using the linkage key to set the customer id), or Close.

paragraphs.name: 3900-EXIT
paragraphs.pseudocode: Return the customer-file status to the caller.

paragraphs.name: 4000-ACCTFILE-PROC
paragraphs.pseudocode: For the account file, execute the requested operation: Open input, keyed Read (using the linkage key to set the account id), or Close.

paragraphs.name: 4900-EXIT
paragraphs.pseudocode: Return the account-file status to the caller.

paragraphs.name: 9999-GOBACK
paragraphs.pseudocode: Return control to the calling program.
